# AntV G6 browser bundle

The local g6.min.js UMD bundle provides the AntV G6 5 Graph, compact-box layout and treeToGraphData APIs. It is loaded on demand only on dependency pages, without a runtime CDN request.

Upstream project: https://github.com/antvis/G6
Documentation: https://g6.antv.antgroup.com/
License text copied from https://raw.githubusercontent.com/antvis/G6/master/LICENSE; see G6-LICENSE.txt. Bundled dependency license comments are retained in g6.min.js.
